# WeatherManager

> **File:** `services/apps/WeatherManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Weather shared by every widget that shows it: one WeatherSource for the Weather settings' location and units, fetching while some widget wants it. Stopped, it keeps its last data, so a widget created again (the overlay reopening) shows it at once while it refreshes. WeatherManager.acquire(owner) WeatherManager.release(owner) WeatherManager.source // .weather .current .condition .place …
